report.summary: Consolidated verification: 1 confirmed high-priority fix (missing GIT_ATTR_GLOBAL pop to prevent candidate-controlled filter execution), multiple undecidable risks in TaskAttempt (gitdir redirection, timeout handling, exception catching) and wiki-index consistency (duplicated resolution logic, divergent edge sets). Recommended immediate action: audit _git_env and TaskAttempt for environment variable stripping and subprocess handling.

risks.description: UNDECIDABLE: gitdir redirection via .git file handling in TaskAttempt may allow candidate to redirect git operations outside intended directory.
UNDECIDABLE: Uncaught TimeoutExpired in _git or TaskAttempt.run could leave processes hanging or bypass time limits.
UNDECIDABLE: TaskAttempt subprocess exception catching may be insufficient, risking process leaks or information exposure.
UNDECIDABLE: Review ledger ordering, artifact_dir fencing, and runner isolation need full implementation audit to prevent cross-candidate contamination.
UNDECIDABLE: Duplicated link resolution logic between wiki and index (links.py vs index.py) may cause incorrect or inconsistent links in diagnostics.
UNDECIDABLE: Index's wiki gate may not replicate links.py's deterministic sort, bounds, and edge types, leading to divergent edge sets.
UNDECIDABLE: Link resolution rules (e.g., _candidates_for) may diverge between wiki and index for the same content.
UNDECIDABLE: Need to decide ownership of resolution logic: wiki layer should export reusable LinkIndex builder, index should call it.
UNDECIDABLE: Ambiguous/unresolved link reporting may be dropped silently by index's document_links, unlike links.py which reports.

todos.description: Add 'GIT_ATTR_GLOBAL' to the pop list in _git_env to prevent candidate-controlled git attribute filter execution. This fixes a missing environment variable strip that could allow arbitrary command execution during git operations.
todos.file: _git_env function (unknown .py file, likely in git utilities)

handoff.suggestion: In the _git_env function, ensure 'GIT_ATTR_GLOBAL' is added to the list of environment variables being popped, alongside GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, etc. Without this, a candidate who can set this variable and reference a controlled attributes file may execute arbitrary git attribute filters. Also audit for other potentially dangerous Git environment variables (e.g., GIT_CONFIG, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM).
